dataInsertLore.label: Insert Lore
dataInsertLore.description: Inserts lines into the lore at a position.

fallback.label: Fallback
fallback.help: Used instead when the pattern matches no line.

dataRemoveLore.label: Remove Lore
dataRemoveLore.description: Removes the lore lines that match a regular expression.

dataTooltipStyle.label: Tooltip Style
dataTooltipStyle.description: The background texture of the tooltip.

dataDyedColor.label: Dyed Color
dataDyedColor.description: The color of dyeable items such as leather armor, as r,g,b.

dataTrim.label: Trim
dataTrim.description: An armor trim with pattern and material.

dataCustomModelData.label: Custom Model Data
dataCustomModelData.description: Sets the custom_model_data component of the item.
dataCustomModelData.hint: Only sets the component. The model the item shows is bound by custom_model_data at the item root.

dataItemModel.label: Item Model
dataItemModel.description: Sets the item_model component of the item.
dataItemModel.hint: Only sets the component; no model is generated. The item_model key at the item root also generates the model.

dataProfile.label: Profile
dataProfile.description: The skin of a player head: a player name, a texture URL or base64.

name.label: The player whose skin the head shows.

texture.label: A skin texture of the resource pack.

url.label: The URL of a skin texture.

base64.label: The skin as base64 texture data.

dataFood.label: Food
dataFood.description: Food values when eaten. The item also needs a consumable component to be edible.

dataEquippable.label: Equippable
dataEquippable.description: The item can be worn in an equipment slot.

damageOnHurt.label: Takes damage when the wearer is hit

equipOnInteract.label: Can be put on a mob by using it

dataUseRemainder.label: Use Remainder
dataUseRemainder.description: The item that is left after using this one.

dataAttributeModifiers.label: Attribute Modifiers
dataAttributeModifiers.description: Vanilla attribute modifiers, e.g. more attack damage in the main hand.

merge.label: Keeps the enchantments the item already has and adds these.

dataPaintingVariant.label: Painting Variant
dataPaintingVariant.description: The painting a painting item places.

dataJukeboxPlayable.label: Jukebox Playable
dataJukeboxPlayable.description: The song a jukebox plays with this item.

dataBlockState.label: Block State
dataBlockState.description: The block state the item places, which also makes placing feel instant for players with high latency.

field.label: A block state of a custom block, written as id[property=value].
Vanilla block properties and their values.

dataWrittenBookContent.label: Written Book Content
dataWrittenBookContent.description: The title, author and pages of a written book (material written_book).

author.label: The author shown in the tooltip.

generation.label: How often the book was copied.
generation.help: 0 original, 1 copy of the original, 2 copy of a copy, 3 tattered.

resolved.label: Whether the text is already resolved.

field.label: Pages as YAML: lists of lines or raw/filtered entries.

dataRandomValues.label: Random Values
dataRandomValues.description: Values rolled once when the item is built and kept on it, never rolled again.

dataFunctions.label: Functions
dataFunctions.description: Functions run while the item is built, e.g. set_variable for values that later data keys read.

dataTags.label: Tags
dataTags.description: Raw NBT tags on the item; a key starting with @ is a dotted path.

dataDynamicLore.label: Dynamic Lore
dataDynamicLore.description: A different lore for each display context the item is shown in.
dataDynamicLore.hint: Read by CraftEngine 26.9 (DynamicLoreProcessor) but not documented on the wiki. The first context is the default.

dataExternal.label: External
dataExternal.description: Takes the data of an item from another plugin.

dataComponents.label: Components
dataComponents.description: Raw vanilla data components. CraftEngine does not check them across versions.

dataRemoveComponents.label: Remove Components
dataRemoveComponents.description: Removes these components from the item.

updater.label: Updater
updater.description: Patches items of an older version in players' inventories when the config changes.
updater.hint: Items below a version run its steps. New items skip the updater, so change data to the final state too. The update triggers are set in config.yml.

clientBoundData.label: Client Bound Data
clientBoundData.description: Item data that is only sent to players and resolved for each of them, such as conditional names and lore.

overwritableItemName.label: A name used only while the item has no custom name.

overwritableItemModel.label: A model used only while the item has none.

overwritableCustomModelData.label: Custom model data used only while the item has none.

overwritableDyedColor.label: A color used only while the item has none.
overwritableDyedColor.help: Read by CraftEngine 26.9 but not documented on the wiki.

overwritableEquippableAssetId.label: An equipment asset used only while the item has none.
overwritableEquippableAssetId.help: Read by CraftEngine 26.9 but not documented on the wiki.

entries.label: Further data keys and conditional entries.

data.label: The data applied while the conditions hold (YAML).

field.label: The value of the data key (YAML).

clientBoundData.hint: Takes the same keys as data. The overwritable keys apply only while the item lacks that value; conditional#name entries apply their data while their conditions hold.

lore.label: Lore lines: plain lines, or entries with priority, operation and conditions.

content.label: The line or lines of this entry (MiniMessage).

priority.label: Order among the entries: lower numbers come first.
priority.help: Unset: the priority of the entry before.

operation.label: Whether the lines go after or before the lines so far.
operation.help: APPEND (default) adds them at the end, PREPEND at the start.

splitLines.label: Splits the lines at line breaks.
splitLines.help: A line with a line break becomes several lore lines.

filtered.label: The text players with the chat filter on see.

applyData.label: apply_data
applyData.help: Applies item data, with the same keys as data.

data.label: The item data to apply.
data.help: YAML with data keys, e.g. item_name or lore.

transmute.label: transmute
transmute.help: Changes the base material and keeps all components and NBT.

reset.label: reset
reset.help: Rebuilds the item from the current config and keeps only what is listed.

keepComponents.label: The components the rebuilt item keeps (1.20.5+).

keepTags.label: The NBT paths the rebuilt item keeps (before 1.20.5).
